subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the headquarters of NSDL Payments Bank situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• The headquarters of NSDL Payments Bank is situated in **Maharashtra**.
 
• NSDL Payments Bank is offering 3-in-1 Savings Account to Customers partnered with Marwadi Financial Services
 
• Marwadi Financial Services has joined hands with NSDL Payments Bank to offer 3-in-1 savings bank accounts with features of savings, Demat (Dematerialised Account), and trading accounts to boost its customer experience. 
 
• This partnership will also allow NSDL Payments Bank to access Marwadi’s clients and expand its customer base.
 
• NSDL Payments Bank is a subsidiary of NSDL (National Securities Depository Limited), the first and the largest depository in India.
